assumption: VFB trace messages pass through the same buffered transmission path (Filter, LogChannel, Dlt_TxFunction, PduR) as explicit trace messages.
rationale: SWS_Dlt_00285 requires an internal function equivalent to Dlt_SendTraceMessage; the VFB sequence diagram in the payload shows only the older DltCom path.
